groups.contract: Travel configuration admission distinguishes finite conversion from native saturation
groups.disposition: Both complete1246-line bodies personally read, fixtures included, and actual textual comparison has no differences. Walking hours is raw f32 clamped0..24 then scaled60/rounded/cast u16. Finite admitted interval cannot overflow1440; NaN instead survives clamp and casts0, and infinities clamp to endpoints. These are source-backed boundary policy dependencies, not a separately promoted defect without the actual itinerary reducer admission/context. Journey start parses two u16 then StrategicMinuteOfDay::from_hour_minute admits one-day bounds before sending. No native duration conversion from user float occurs here.

groups.contract: Camp display queries, retry limits and coherent current-state gates
groups.disposition: Party, journey and direct-demo challenge retries are bounded to four attempts with fixed150ms sleeps. Query errors/absent projection can still redirect or supply empty challenge data; preserve distinct unavailable-vs-absent contract from RIG-PPS-F021 rather than claiming the retries establish consistency. Encounter query error explicitly returns503 before travel controls render. Direct demo IDs parse exact segments/numeric actor and reject extras; road challenge takes priority and automatic redirect requires exactly one playable demo. Full fixtures read, not run. Current party clock is max of available member times with ZERO fallback; unlike other departure helpers it includes listed dead members. Whether this causes actual inconsistency depends on real active-member selection and immutable journey anchors, still a cross-file dependency, not a new runtime claim.

groups.contract: Remaining interval arithmetic and diagnostic selection preserve bounds but retain endpoint semantics
groups.disposition: Remaining elapsed/movement uses saturation to avoid underflow. Forecast camp intervals intersect represented starts/ends, subtract only after end>start; adding absolute start saturates at the canonical clock endpoint and must retain the shared explicit endpoint policy rather than silently prove full elapsed conservation. History requested-index comes from the same list so swap(0,index) only runs on a nonempty valid list, then truncate10. Endpoint list is at most two and deduplicated by settlement identity. Rest validates requested duration and field shelter before reducer call; continue/change-destination delegates actual authority and errors to reducers. No transaction/rollback or successful backend execution claimed.

groups.contract: Provision aggregation and physical custody remain actual producer-to-forecast dependencies
groups.disposition: Only living travelers enter the sorted forecast list. Required catalog/needs absence yields None; fetch failures return a cause converted to String, while query_single time/personality can erase unavailability and alter the fallback personality forecast. Containers are fetched together but this alone does not promise one database snapshot. Own personal/party food and quantity filtering is by actual IDs; carried water uses physical custody at camp, whereas departing settlement counts refillable skins. Quantity sums and += use u32 with no overflow checks, food/water f32 totals can overflow, and traveler usize narrows to u32. These are retained API/admission strengthening dependencies pending concrete accepted inventory/population bounds, not asserted ordinary oversized inventory. Evening derivation uses fallible canonical rest_evenings and checked prior<evening guard before subtraction; sort/dedup gives one demand per evening/traveler. Forecast output accepts these aggregates without local readmission; owning PartyProvisioningInputs and canonical quantity/nutrition producer contracts must settle computation/error policy. Preserve full abstract coordinates and signed elevation policies from related routes, and existing drinking chronology/order.
